question: The interface vocabulary has no memcached term. MemCachier is a managed Memcached cache reached over the Memcached text protocol, which is not one of the closed interface values; the draft uses 'unknown' and names the real interface in interface_detail. Should a 'memcached' interface value be added to the schema?
why: Forcing the Memcached text protocol into an unrelated term would misstate the interface; the nearest term 'unknown' was used instead.

new.slice: The interface vocabulary has no memcached term. MemCachier is a managed Memcache
